slices.focus: Saira codifies the modernized dispensing system into an internal operations file after consistently hitting the 15-minute target
slices.summary: With the after-school rush regularly hitting under 15 minutes, Saira creates an internal operations file with shelf layout photos, handoff scripts, a locum section, and monthly measures. She plans to pilot it with one quick skeptical team member first, then a locum, making the system durable beyond her own presence.
